digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow scheduling and cancellation
propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; full-route jobs with always() predicates remain true and are not canceled when a superseding patchset arrives.

Commit 6f4123678c added always() to seven full-route job predicates, preventing prompt cancellation; live run pair 31834162663→31834896849 showed 1,510s successor delay and 1,785 runner-seconds consumed after replacement creation.

The fix replaces only the cancellation-status portion of the seven full-route predicates with !cancelled() checks, preserving all other conditions (clear-vote, ticket, classifier-result, route) unchanged.

Full-route jobs must remain eligible when classifier fails and the run is not canceled, and must become ineligible when the workflow run is canceled, maintaining docs-only contract fail-closed behavior.

Post-merge organic same-change patchset pairs (1790 PS3→PS4→PS5) demonstrate prompt cancellation: stale runs end canceled 61–110s after replacement creation, with successor jobs admitted without waiting for natural matrix completion.
